mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_mcp_job WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT j.id FROM afv_canvas_mcp_job j JOIN afv_canvas_mcp_contract c ON c.id=j.contract_id WHERE (j.status='READY' OR (j.status='RUNNING' AND j.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) AND (j.permit_held=TRUE OR j.cancel_requested=TRUE OR j.request_started_at IS NOT NULL OR j.deadline_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) OR c.enabled=FALSE OR c.deleted=TRUE OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_canvas_mcp_job busy WHERE busy.contract_id=j.contract_id AND busy.permit_held=TRUE)) ORDER BY j.created_at,j.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_mcp_job WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_instance_id=#{owner} AND owner_epoch=#{epoch} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_mcp_job SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,90,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE id=#{id} AND owner_instance_id=#{owner} AND owner_epoch=#{epoch} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE afv_canvas_mcp_job SET request_started_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),request_owner_instance_id=#{owner},request_owner_epoch=#{epoch}, revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND request_started_at IS NULL
UPDATE afv_canvas_mcp_job SET cancel_requested=TRUE,revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND cancel_requested=FALSE
